Definition: a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel
BiblicalUsage: Hiel the Beth-elite is the only man this word ever describes, and his story is a grim one. In 1 Kings 16:34 he rebuilt Jericho in the days of Ahab, laying its foundation in his firstborn Abiram and setting up its gates in his youngest son, exactly as Joshua had warned. The word simply means a man from Bethel — but this Beth-elite paid the old curse in full.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hiel's story is Joshua's warning coming true word for word, and it tells me God's warnings outlive the men who spoke them.
